micro.title: What this gives you
micro.lead: The nutrients in this portion that actually matter for your progress, as a share of your day.
micro.none: This portion brings no standout micronutrient: it is here for its calories and protein.

why.iron: Carries oxygen to the muscle. Running low means gasping by the third set.
why.zinc: Supports testosterone and tissue repair after a heavy session.
why.magnesium: Muscle contraction, sleep and recovery: the first to run short when you train daily.
why.calcium: Strong bones and muscle contraction, under load and at rest.
why.potassium: Fluid balance and contraction; you sweat it out every session.
why.vitaminC: Helps absorb plant iron and maintains tendons and joints.
why.vitaminD: Strength and testosterone. The most common deficiency in France, hence the supplement.
why.omega3: Lowers inflammation between sessions and speeds up recovery.
